name: Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS (JSON)
summary: Resolve DNS records through Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 resolver with a JSON-over-HTTPS GET.
description: cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query answers A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME and other record queries as JSON when the request carries Accept: application/dns-json. It supports the DO (DNSSEC) and CD (checking disabled) bits and numeric or text record types, and works from browsers and scripts without a DNS library.

required_headers.name: Accept
required_headers.notes: Without this header the same URL returned HTTP 400.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the page fetched.

endpoints.summary: Resolve a name and record type, JSON answer

agent_notes: Always send Accept: application/dns-json. type accepts names (A, MX, TXT) or numbers. Status is the DNS RCODE (0 NOERROR, 3 NXDOMAIN). TTL values are seconds remaining in the resolver cache. The sibling Google service (google-dns-doh) has the same JSON shape on /resolve.
caveats: The JSON format is Cloudflare's documented 'JSON API' variant, not the RFC 8484 wire format (which uses application/dns-message).

verification.notes: Exact example executed with the Accept header; no key exists.
